useCase: Verifying physical plausibility of lighting and sombra configurations en imágenes
mechanism: Estimates light source direction using spherical harmonics decomposition on detected surfaces and objects. Compara estimated lighting vectors a través de different image regions. generado por IA images often contain physically impossible lighting configurations where sombra directions contradict the apparent light source position.
accuracy: Moderada - 70-80% on images with clear lighting cues
name: Análisis de Consistencia de Iluminación
source: Johnson & Farid (2005) - Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Inconsistencies in Lighting, ACM Workshop
parameters: Harmonics: order 2 (9 coeficientes), Surface normal estimation: shape-from-shading, Light probes: face/object regions, Consistency metric: angular deviation
description: Estimates light source direction and consistency a través de image regions. AI images often have physically impossible lighting configurations with inconsistent sombra directions.

references.title: Johnson, M.K. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Inconsistencies in Lighting. ACM Workshop MMS.
Kee, E. et al. (2013). Exposing Digital Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Shadows. ACM TOMM.

strengths:
• Based on physics of light propagation
• Detecta physically impossible scenes
• Effective for composite image detección
• Works on both indoor and outdoor scenes
limitations:
• Requires identifiable surfaces for normal estimation
• Complex scenes with multiple light sources are challenging
• Diffuse lighting reduces detección precisión
• Modern AI models improving at consistencia de iluminación
